message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: 黄1某 is a full-time staff (事业工人) responsible for school cafeteria funds management. He used transfer checks, forged stamps and principal's seal to transfer from cafeteria's dedicated account to his mother's account, to repay his guarantee loan. He repeatedly transferred or withdrew cash, repaid part. Total misappropriated public funds 2,829,550.2 yuan (282.95502万). 1,760,574.67 yuan still not repaid. The prosecution says he is a state employee (国家工作人员) using position to embezzle public funds, over 3 months not returned, serious. So crime: Embezzlement of public funds (挪用公款罪). In Chinese criminal law, "挪用公款罪" is the charge. Also possibly "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribes. He just misappropriated. So single charge: 挪用公款.
